title: stdlib-windows-portability says which result of a removed working directory is documented for Linux and which a macOS run showed
goal: The fact at kb/public/python/stdlib-windows-portability.md on a removed cwd says getcwd ENOENT (Linux, documented) and relative-path open ENOENT (one macOS run only)

run: import re,sys;L=[l for l in open('kb/public/python/stdlib-windows-portability.md',encoding='utf-8') if l.startswith('- So on Linux and macOS')];t=L[0] if L else '';g=[m.start() for m in re.finditer('getcwd',t)];r=[m.start() for m in re.finditer('relative',t)];ok=bool(g) and bool(r) and all(re.search('Linux|documented',t[max(0,i-100):i+100]) for i in g) and all('macOS' in t[max(0,i-100):i+100] for i in r);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
